mixedMaterialRule.instruction: No current fresh-only or artificial-only material rule was verified for these candidates. Do not invent one. Where supplier products mix fresh/artificial flowers, all material compatibility remains unverified until a venue/event-specific policy supports acceptance. If a later explicit fresh-only rule conflicts with a product, hold that product; do not silently claim it is all-fresh. Samsung 조화 display wording is not material evidence.

editorialDecision.recommendation: Research proposal only, not a publication approval decision. Use directly verified facts and restrictions in accurate buyer guidance; unresolved order-specific receipt details can be confirmed during order consultation. Do not promise unrestricted admission, guaranteed timing or material suitability. Hold a proposed claim or use case when an explicit prohibition, missing essential fact or unresolved contradiction would make it misleading. Candidate selection does not require separate pages or justify neighborhood cloning; this packet adds no approval requirement.
